reason: Modify-items on order #W1845024 removes the Mechanical Keyboard, Headphones, and Office Chair but supplies no new_item_ids for them (empty new_item_ids array) and no payment method purpose tied to a price difference. Policy requires that for a pending order, each item to be modified must be changed 'to an available new item of the same product but of different product option' — items cannot simply be dropped/removed. The user actually wants to remove items from an order entirely (a partial cancellation), which is not a supported action: 'Generally, you can only take action on pending or delivered orders' with only cancel (whole order), modify address/payment/items (swap to different option, not deletion), return, or exchange being permitted. There is no mechanism to remove items from a pending order while keeping the rest. The proposed tool call misuses modify_pending_order_items to delete items rather than swap them for same-product different-option variants, which is not supported by policy, and would also irreversibly lock the order (status becomes 'pending (items modified)') based on an unsupported operation.
policy_references: For a pending order, each item can be modified to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types, e.g. modify shirt to shoe.
Generally, you can only take action on pending or delivered orders.
This action can only be called once, and will change the order status to 'pending (items modifed)'.
